# FitNotes CSV fixtures (synthetic)

Every file here was written by hand for tests. None is a real export and none
holds anyone's personal data. Headers follow
`docs/research/fitnotes-export-format.md` §2 (A1-lb and C verbatim from the
sample and the official docs; A1-kg, A2, B1 and B2 are probable only). Before
the importer is called done, Ben's real export's first line is added here as
`ben-header.synthetic.csv` (header only, no rows).
